summary.text: Dave Bennett is the Republican candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 149 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An engineer and small business owner, he says his career has focused on critical infrastructure and cybersecurity in the oil and gas industry.

paragraphs.text: Dave Bennett advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as engineer.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Bennett described himself as a small business owner and electrical engineer with a career in the oil and gas industry focused on critical infrastructure, energy systems and cybersecurity.
In the same survey, Bennett listed his key messages as public safety, economic security and infrastructure resilience.

He said he supports strengthening enforcement policies to reduce repeat offenses, property tax reform and protections for small business owners, and solutions for flooding, water systems and energy reliability.
